maintainer_affiliation: This guide is maintained by the TokenDos operator.
selection: Three catalog examples from the OpenAI protocol group; not the complete catalog.
limitations: Input, output and cache minima can come from different suppliers.
This snapshot does not identify a single supplier offering all component minima together.
Catalog model identifiers are supplier labels, not independent model authentication.
Prices and supply change; use the selected node's complete quote and actual bill.
Official-reference ratios apply an operator currency-conversion basis and are not used to derive discounts here.
These API catalog prices do not establish available member-session supply.
